A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an algorithm to estimate the parameters of an AR causal model excited by a non Gaussian, unobservable, ergodic process, and contaminated by Gaussian colored noise.
we have shown that it is possible to use a linear combination of higher order statistics (HOS), of any order, for the estimation of AR models.
the proposed method is an extension to the cumulant-based AR modeling of the classical linear prediction method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of cumulants of a single order is suboptimal and that the combination of cumulants from different orders can improve performance.
, by using cumulant slices of different orders, the number of parameters of the model may be reduced, while the number of samples required to estimate them may be kept unchanged.
the cumulant slices of a non-Gaussian AR process may be combined to provide a consistent estimation of the AR parameters.
